description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1) Hello, pastor I have a question for you. Heb 4:15 says Christ was tempted just as we are tempted, and James 1:13 - 14 says the way we are tempted; everyone is tempted when drawn by his/her own desires and when the desire is conceived sin occurs. So if Christ was tempted just as we are tempted it means He had to be tempted within his body and also outside from my understanding, but I got this quotation, in 7ABC chapter 7 that says Christ never had evil propensities what does the prophetess mean here in this chapter because I am not getting her message? Will be waiting for the answer.
.
2) "What is Jacob's time of trouble? When does this happen?
Is it true that it happens during or after the 7 plagues and after the close of probation? Do people confess all their sins at that time? How can they confess all their sins if the probation was closed?
I am a bit confused about this. Can I get some clear answers from the Scripture as well as the SOP?"
.
.
